result.summary: PASS. Coverage vs design section 5: 0xFF refused = test 'all-0xFF ... refused'; zeros refused = 'all-zeros ... refused'; valid key accepted = third test (exit 0, marker present, no 'trivially-guessable'); no key echo = refute output =~ full 64-char key in the shared helper; pepper not masking = shared env with valid distinct pepper pair (ab x 32, id p1) in all three; Change B (docs) is not a test criterion. Assertions are discriminating: refused cases assert exit != 0, 'trivially-guessable', 'LETFLOW_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY', marker absence and no key echo, not just nonzero exit. Valid-key test asserts the key differs from the pepper. Fixtures self-sufficient: each test spawns its own mix run with explicit env, MIX_TEST_PARTITION/MIX_BUILD_PATH nil'd, async-safe, no shared state, no @tag :skip, no TODO, no secrets (test-only pepper/key literals).
